mapper.sql: id, stage_id, chapter_order, goal, expected_progress, target_characters, must_advance, must_not_do, story_beats, ending_intent, plan_version, active, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO chapter_plan (stage_id, chapter_order, goal, expected_progress, target_characters, must_advance, must_not_do, story_beats, ending_intent, plan_version, active, status) VALUES
(#{p.stageId}, #{p.chapterOrder}, #{p.goal}, #{p.expectedProgress}, #{p.targetCharacters}, #{p.mustAdvance}, #{p.mustNotDo}, #{p.storyBeats}, #{p.endingIntent}, #{p.planVersion}, #{p.active}, #{p.status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chapter_plan WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY chapter_order ASC
SELECT FROM chapter_plan WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND active = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY chapter_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_plan SET status = 'COMPLETED', active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE chapter_plan SET target_characters = #{targetCharacters}, must_advance = #{mustAdvance}, must_not_do = #{mustNotDo}, story_beats = #{storyBeats}, ending_intent = #{endingIntent} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chapter_plan SET active = 0, status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND active = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
